chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad ibn Abu Hamza and others, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There is goodness for you in my life and goodness for you in my death.'
So it was said, 'O Messenger of Allah! As for your life, we have known (that). But what is for us in your passing away?'
He said: 'As for my life, then indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: “And it was not for Allah to punish them while you are among them”.'
And as for my passing away, your deeds will be presented to me, so I will seek forgiveness for you.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit for believers in the Prophet's death?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the concept of *al-Hadhr al-Mawjood* (the presence of the Prophet) after death, a key tenet in Shia theology, asserting that the Prophet’s soul remains active in receiving the deeds of the Ummah. While his physical presence during life served as a divine shield against punishment (referencing Surah Al-Anfal), his posthumous intercession (*Shafa'ah*) continues to benefit believers through his supplication for their forgiveness.

en.hubeali: H 14809 – Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza and someone else, has reported the following:
Abu Abdullahasws says that the Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘There is goodness for you in mysaww being alive and goodness for you in mysaww passing away’.
So they said, ‘O Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup>! As for your<sup>saww</sup> being alive, so we have known that. So what is (goodness) for us in your<sup>saww</sup> passing away?’
Hesaww said: ‘As for mysaww being alive, so Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Said: “[8:33] But Allah was not going to chastise them while you were among them”.
And as for my<sup>saww</sup> passing away, your deeds would get presented to me<sup>saww</sup>, so I<sup>saww</sup> would be seeking Forgiveness for you’.
en.sarwar: 362. Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza and someone else, has reported the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) says that the Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘There is goodness for you in my (saww) being alive and goodness for you in my (saww) passing away’.
So they said, ‘O Rasool Allah (saww)! As for your (saww) being alive, so we have known that. So what is (goodness) for us in your (saww) passing away?’
He (saww) said: ‘As for my (saww) being alive, so Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic has Said: “[8:33] But Allah was not going to chastise them while you were among them”.
And as for my (saww) passing away, your deeds would get presented to me (saww), so I (saww) would be seeking Forgiveness for you’.
